class.name: AttributeSet
class.brief_description: Defines a set of numeric attributes for the Gameplay Ability System.
class.description: AttributeSet holds the data for attributes (e.g., Health, Mana, Strength). Each attribute has a Base Value (permanent) and a Current Value (temporary, affected by buffs/effects). Use this resource to define the stats of a character or object.

method.name: get_attribute_base
method.description: Returns the permanent, base value of the attribute.

method.name: get_attribute_current
method.description: Returns the current value of the attribute, which includes active temporary modifiers.

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Checks if an attribute with the given name exists in this set.

method.name: set_attribute_base
method.description: Sets the base value of the attribute.

method.name: set_attribute_current
method.description: Sets the current value of the attribute directly. NOTE: Typically, you should use GameplayEffects to modify values rather than setting them directly.
